This is unexpected—if the warnings were being emitted, `-W error::DeprecationWarning` should have promoted them to errors and failed the run. Either the check is running on a machine/environment where the warnings don't occur (e.g., not Python 3.13, or not multi-threaded at that moment), or the tests are already suppressing them somehow. A valid check must fail on current behavior and pass only after the fix is applied; this one passes now, so it would grade "doing nothing" as success.
